<a id="script_down_back"></a>
### [`script_down_back`](../../../../src/fighter/anim_scripts.asm#L83) `$7832-$7855`

*data*

Animation $08: move 8 (joystick down-back), a somersault back in an arc. 9 steps of 4 bytes: delay, frame, dx, dy. dx counts in each frame of a step, so the steps move the fighter 39 units back in all. Frames $19, $17, $16, $20, $15, $14. The step with frame $15 moves 11 units forward at once, to match the frames.

- **Entry of:** [`anim_script_table`](../../tables.md#anim_script_table)
